uq_job_idempotency.name: uq_job_idempotency
uq_job_idempotency.where: "AnalysisJob"."userId" is not null and "AnalysisJob"."idempotencyKey" is not null

uq_artifact_chat_logical_id.name: uq_artifact_chat_logical_id
uq_artifact_chat_logical_id.where: "Artifact"."logicalId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_user.name: idx_artifact_user
idx_artifact_user.where: "Artifact"."userId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_chat.name: idx_artifact_chat
idx_artifact_chat.where: "Artifact"."chatId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_message.name: idx_artifact_message
idx_artifact_message.where: "Artifact"."messageId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_generation.name: idx_artifact_generation
idx_artifact_generation.where: "Artifact"."generationId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_job.name: idx_artifact_job
idx_artifact_job.where: "Artifact"."analysisJobId" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

idx_artifact_expiry.name: idx_artifact_expiry
idx_artifact_expiry.where: "Artifact"."expiresAt" is not null and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null

chk_artifact_storage.name: chk_artifact_storage
chk_artifact_storage.value:
("Artifact"."storageProvider" is null and "Artifact"."storageKey" is null)
        or ("Artifact"."storageProvider" is not null and "Artifact"."storageKey" is not null)

chk_artifact_ready_content.name: chk_artifact_ready_content
chk_artifact_ready_content.value: "Artifact"."status" <> 'ready' or "Artifact"."content" is not null or "Artifact"."storageKey" is not null

chk_artifact_message_chat_presence.name: chk_artifact_message_chat_presence
chk_artifact_message_chat_presence.value: "Artifact"."messageId" is null or "Artifact"."chatId" is not null

idx_attachment_sha.name: idx_attachment_sha
idx_attachment_sha.where: "Attachment"."sha256" is not null and "Attachment"."deletedAt" is null

chk_chat_fork_state.name: chk_chat_fork_state
chk_chat_fork_state.value:
(
        ("Chat"."forkedFromChatId" is null and "Chat"."forkedFromSeq" is null)
        or
        ("Chat"."forkedFromChatId" is not null and "Chat"."forkedFromSeq" is not null
          and "Chat"."forkedFromSeq" >= 1 and "Chat"."forkedFromChatId" <> "Chat"."id")
      )

chk_chat_share_state.name: chk_chat_share_state
chk_chat_share_state.value:
(
        ("Chat"."shareScope" = 'private' and "Chat"."shareMode" is null
          and "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq" is null and "Chat"."sharedAt" is null
          and "Chat"."shareSlug" is null)
        or
        ("Chat"."shareScope" = 'authenticated' and "Chat"."shareMode" = 'snapshot'
          and "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq" is not null and "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq" >= 1
          and "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq" < "Chat"."nextMessageSeq"
          and "Chat"."sharedAt" is not null and "Chat"."shareSlug" is not null)
        or
        ("Chat"."shareScope" = 'authenticated' and "Chat"."shareMode" = 'live'
          and "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq" is null and "Chat"."sharedAt" is not null
          and "Chat"."shareSlug" is not null)
      )

chk_generation_latency.name: chk_generation_latency
chk_generation_latency.value:
("Generation"."latencyMs" is null or "Generation"."latencyMs" >= 0)
        and ("Generation"."timeToFirstTokenMs" is null or "Generation"."timeToFirstTokenMs" >= 0)

chk_generation_cancel_fields.name: chk_generation_cancel_fields
chk_generation_cancel_fields.value:
("Generation"."cancelRequestedAt" is null and "Generation"."cancelSource" is null)
        or ("Generation"."cancelRequestedAt" is not null and "Generation"."cancelSource" is not null)

chk_generation_finished_at.name: chk_generation_finished_at
chk_generation_finished_at.value:
("Generation"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', 'timed_out') and "Generation"."finishedAt" is not null)
        or ("Generation"."status" in ('created', 'queued', 'scheduled', 'running', 'cancelling') and "Generation"."finishedAt" is null)

public.SharedArtifact.definition:
select "Artifact"."id", "Artifact"."chatId", "Artifact"."messageId", "Artifact"."title", "Artifact"."artifactType", "Artifact"."format", "Artifact"."status", "Artifact"."content", "Artifact"."mimeType", "Artifact"."sizeBytes", "Artifact"."storageKey" is not null as "hasStoredContent", "Artifact"."createdAt", "Artifact"."updatedAt", "Artifact"."expiresAt" from "Artifact" inner join "Message" on "Message"."id" = "Artifact"."messageId" and "Message"."chatId" = "Artifact"."chatId" inner join "Chat" on "Chat"."id" = "Artifact"."chatId" where 
      "Chat"."shareScope" = 'authenticated'
      and "Chat"."deletedAt" is null
      and "Artifact"."isChatShareable" = true
      and "Artifact"."status" = 'ready'
      and "Message"."status" = 'completed'
      and "Artifact"."deletedAt" is null
      and ("Artifact"."expiresAt" is null or "Artifact"."expiresAt" > now())
      and (
        "Chat"."shareMode" = 'live'
        or ("Chat"."shareMode" = 'snapshot' and "Message"."seq" <= "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq")
      )
public.SharedArtifact.name: SharedArtifact

public.SharedChatMessage.definition:
select "Message"."id", "Message"."chatId", "Message"."seq", "Message"."role", "Message"."sharedText", "Message"."createdAt" from "Message" inner join "Chat" on "Chat"."id" = "Message"."chatId" where 
      "Chat"."shareScope" = 'authenticated'
      and "Chat"."deletedAt" is null
      and "Message"."role" in ('user', 'assistant')
      and "Message"."status" = 'completed'
      and "Message"."sharedText" is not null
      and (
        "Chat"."shareMode" = 'live'
        or ("Chat"."shareMode" = 'snapshot' and "Message"."seq" <= "Chat"."sharedThroughSeq")
      )
public.SharedChatMessage.name: SharedChatMessage

public.SharedChat.definition: select "id", "userId" as "ownerUserId", "title", "chatType", "shareMode", "sharedThroughSeq", "sharedAt", "shareSlug", "createdAt", "updatedAt" from "Chat" where "Chat"."shareScope" = 'authenticated' and "Chat"."deletedAt" is null
public.SharedChat.name: SharedChat
